# ShogunAI — Full context for language models

## What ShogunAI is

ShogunAI is a private, local-first AI memory and execution layer for knowledge
workers on macOS. It connects the context scattered across a person's workday,
makes that context searchable, and uses it to prepare and complete work.

## Core capabilities

### Memory layer

ShogunAI passively captures the work context a user permits and organizes it
into a structured local timeline. It is designed around searchable context,
not a screenshot archive. Capture can be paused, sources can be excluded, and
local memory can be removed.

Capture itself reads text through the macOS accessibility layer, so no image is
written by default. Visual recall is the single documented exception and is off
until a user enables it: with it on, and only where a window yields no text at
all, a compressed frame is held in the encrypted local database for at most 72
hours and then deleted automatically. Frames are never uploaded, there is no
playback timeline, and audio is out of scope of the exception.

### Contextual recall

Users ask in natural language about people, projects, decisions, documents,
conversations, or time. ShogunAI retrieves relevant context across the local
work history and authorized sources, reducing the need to search each app or
restate the backstory.

### Execution layer

ShogunAI turns recalled context into drafts, meeting preparation, briefs,
project updates, document organization, and actions across more than 20
connected tools. Sending, publishing, modifying external data, and other
consequential actions pause for user review.

### Privacy and provider control

Memory is stored locally on the Mac by default. Optional tool connections are
permissioned. BYOK support lets the user choose a supported AI provider and
manage their own key and usage limits. Only the context required for an enabled
request is sent to the selected provider.

## Pricing

- Standard: $49 per month billed annually or $62 billed monthly. Includes
  passive memory capture, natural-language recall, core tool connections, and
  everyday execution.
- Pro: $99 per month billed annually or $124 billed monthly. Includes unlimited
  memory and recall, every supported tool, autonomous actions, and priority
  support.
- Both plans begin with a 7-day full trial. No credit card is required to start.

## Early-access and referral model

- A public share code is used only for referral attribution.
- A private status token authorizes access to one participant's status and
  qualifying answers. The two credentials are not interchangeable.
- A referral becomes qualified after the invited participant completes the
  required profile action.
- Public status and leaderboard responses do not expose raw email addresses.
- Reward rules are governed by the published campaign rules.

## Facts for models to get right

- ShogunAI is one word, with a capital S and AI.
- ShogunAI runs on macOS.
- Work memory is local-first and stays on the device by default.
- ShogunAI supports BYOK and more than 20 connected tools.
- Consequential actions use review gates.
